tradition.heading: Why Antwerp Celebrates Mother's Day on 15 August
paragraphs: Most of Belgium celebrates Mother's Day on the second Sunday of May, but Antwerp follows an older local tradition. In 1913, Antwerp artist and alderman Frans Van Kuyck proposed honouring mothers on 15 August.

The date coincides with the Assumption of Mary, who has been Antwerp's patroness since 1124. More than a century later, families still mark the day with flowers, time together and the Antwerp Mother's Day breakfast—often waffles, strawberries, chocolate rolls and coffee or tea.
This local history gives a Mother's Day gift sourced in Antwerp a genuine connection to place, not a borrowed seasonal slogan.

whyLoose.heading: Choose the Natural Diamond First—Then Create the Piece Together
paragraphs: A loose natural diamond can be a meaningful starting point when the final design should remain personal. The recipient can choose the setting, metal and style with a trusted jeweller after Mother's Day, while the giver presents the stone and its grading information on the day itself.

GIA advises that buying a diamond loose and deciding on the mounting later can be useful when the wearer's preferences are not yet known. A recognised laboratory grading report also provides an independent description of the diamond's 4Cs, identifies whether it is natural or laboratory-grown, and records disclosed treatments.
For a Mother's Day gift, that means the emotion can remain personal while the purchase stays informed.

items.title: Matched Round Brilliant Pair — for classic earrings
items.body: Ask Dalila to source two natural diamonds matched for diameter, outline, colour, clarity and overall brightness. The jeweller completes the setting; Dalila supplies the stones.

items.title: Heart-Shaped Natural Diamond — for a symbolic pendant or ring
items.body: A heart shape makes the Mother's Day meaning immediately visible. Ask to compare outline, symmetry, proportions and face-up appearance rather than selecting by carat weight alone.

items.title: Oval or Pear Natural Diamond — for an elegant one-of-one piece
items.body: Elongated shapes suit pendants, rings and modern bespoke designs. Ask for several options with measurements and videos so the jeweller can compare outline and visual spread.

items.title: Round Brilliant Natural Diamond — for a versatile solitaire
items.body: A round brilliant works across pendants and rings and gives the jeweller broad design flexibility. Prioritise an attractive face-up appearance and review the complete grading information within budget.

items.title: Calibrated Natural-Diamond Melee or a Matched Layout — for a family design
items.body: Small, consistently matched natural diamonds can represent children, generations or important milestones in a custom piece. The jeweller should specify dimensions, count, colour, clarity and setting plan before Dalila prepares the layout.

guide.heading: How to Brief the Right Natural Diamond
paragraphs: Start with the finished idea, not a carat number. Tell Dalila whether the jeweller needs a centre stone, matched pair, side stones or melee; the preferred shape; the total stone budget; the grading-report preference; and the date the jeweller must receive the diamonds.

Then compare the 4Cs—carat, colour, clarity and cut—together with measurements, proportions, fluorescence and face-up appearance. For round brilliants, cut has a particularly visible effect on brightness, fire and scintillation. For fancy shapes such as hearts, ovals and pears, outline and visual balance also matter.
A concise, complete brief allows the Antwerp sourcing team to return relevant current-stock or custom-sourced options instead of a generic stock list.

faqs.heading: Questions About Antwerp Mother's Day and Natural Diamonds

items.q: When is Mother's Day in Antwerp in 2026?
items.a: Antwerp Mother's Day falls on Saturday, 15 August 2026. The Antwerp tradition is tied to the date, not to a particular weekday.

items.q: When is Antwerp Mother's Day in 2027?
Why does Antwerp celebrate Mother's Day on 15 August?
items.a: Antwerp's local celebration was promoted in 1913 by artist and alderman Frans Van Kuyck. The date coincides with the Assumption of Mary, Antwerp's patroness since 1124.

items.q: Is Mother's Day celebrated on 15 August everywhere in Belgium?
items.a: No. Most of Belgium celebrates on the second Sunday of May. Antwerp and parts of the surrounding province maintain the 15 August tradition.

items.q: What is a traditional Antwerp Mother's Day breakfast?
items.a: Families often celebrate with breakfast in bed or a shared morning meal. Waffles, strawberries, chocolate rolls and coffee or tea are commonly associated with the local tradition.

items.q: Does Dalila Diamonds sell Mother's Day jewellery?
items.a: No. Dalila supplies loose natural diamonds to jewellery professionals. A jeweller or atelier designs, sets and services the finished piece.
No. This page and Dalila's sourcing service are for natural diamonds only.

items.q: Can a loose natural diamond be given as a Mother's Day gift?
items.a: Yes. A loose diamond can be presented with its grading information, then set later with the recipient and a trusted jeweller. Confirm secure presentation, insurance and the setting plan before purchase.

items.q: Which natural diamond shape is best for a Mother's Day gift?
items.a: There is no single best shape. Round brilliants are versatile, hearts are overtly symbolic, and ovals or pears suit elegant bespoke designs. The best choice is the one that fits the intended piece, wearer's style and budget.

items.q: Can Dalila source a matched pair of natural diamonds?
items.a: Yes, subject to specifications and availability. A strong pair should match not only carat weight but also measurements, outline, colour, clarity and visual brightness.

items.q: What does a diamond grading report tell me?
items.a: An independent grading report describes quality factors such as carat, colour, clarity and cut information. It can also identify whether a diamond is natural or laboratory-grown and disclose detected treatments. Check the report directly with the issuing laboratory.

items.q: Is an "Antwerp diamond" mined in Belgium?
items.a: Not necessarily. Antwerp is a diamond trading and sourcing centre. "Sourced through Antwerp" should not be confused with the country where the rough diamond was mined.

items.q: Can Dalila source a specific carat, colour or clarity?
items.a: Yes. Qualified trade buyers can submit a custom brief by shape, carat or measurements, colour, clarity, grading-report preference, budget and deadline.

items.q: Can I collect a diamond in Antwerp for Mother's Day?
items.a: Collection may be possible for an approved trade order, but it must be confirmed in advance. Do not assume weekend or public-holiday availability.

items.q: How early should a jeweller order for 15 August?
items.a: Start several weeks ahead whenever possible. Sourcing, comparison, approval, insured transport and jewellery setting each require time. Last-minute options depend on current stock and the jeweller's workshop schedule.

items.q: How do I request natural-diamond options for Mother's Day?
items.a: Send Dalila the intended piece, preferred shape, quantity, carat or dimensions, colour, clarity, report preference, budget and required date. The team can then confirm the next sourcing step and current feasibility.
